videos.title: New World Sectors with Cunard Line
videos.description: Discover extraordinary Cunard voyages aboard Queen Elizabeth, from Southampton to South Africa, Asia and Australia, plus luxury Caribbean escapes and early booking savings.

videos.title: Black Friday Sale: NCL
videos.description: Enjoy all inclusive Black Friday escapes with Norwegian Cruise Line to Alaska, the Mediterranean, Caribbean, Australia and New Zealand, with savings of up to £400 per booking.

videos.title: Derek's New MSC 2028 Adventures
videos.description: Join Derek for 2 exciting 2028 adventures with MSC, exploring the Caribbean and Panama aboard MSC Poesia or Italy, Sicily and Malta aboard the brand new MSC World Asia.

videos.title: Black Friday Sale: Azamara Cruises
videos.description: Experience luxury small ship cruising with Azamara, exploring Africa and the Caribbean with drinks, gratuities and more included, plus Black Friday savings of up to £2,330 per couple.

videos.title: Black Friday Sale: Princess
videos.description: Discover luxury no fly cruises with Princess Cruises to Scandinavia, the Mediterranean and Ireland, with Black Friday savings of up to £560 per booking and deposits from £119pp.

videos.title: Black Friday Sale: Ambassador
videos.description: Discover all inclusive Black Friday cruise deals with Ambassador, sailing from ports across the UK to the Norwegian Fjords, Mediterranean, Canaries and more, with low deposits from £199pp.

videos.description: Enjoy Black Friday savings of up to £755 per booking with Royal Caribbean, featuring Mediterranean adventures aboard Legend of the Seas and spectacular Iceland and Greenland cruising.

videos.description: Discover brand new luxury Celebrity Cruises adventures from Los Angeles to Chile and Singapore to Sydney, with drinks and WiFi included and Black Friday savings of up to £590 per couple.
